description: This file contains unit tests for the HolidayService class within the OrangeHRM leave plugin, specifically testing holiday retrieval, saving, and search functionalities with various filters and conditions.

classes.name: HolidayServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the HolidayService methods and behaviors.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test fixtures including loading config, setting up the holiday service instance, and resetting cache.

methods.name: testGetSetHolidayDao
methods.description: Tests the default getHolidayDao method to confirm it returns an instance of HolidayDao.

methods.name: testSaveHoliday
methods.description: Tests saving a Holiday object via the service with mocked DAO interaction.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysNoneRecurring
methods.description: Verifies searchHolidays returns correct non-recurring holidays within date range.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysRecurringCurrentYear
methods.description: Verifies that recurring holidays are correctly returned for the current year.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysRecurringOtherYear
methods.description: Checks correct handling and filtering of recurring holidays across different years.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysMultiYear
methods.description: Tests retrieval of recurring holidays spanning multiple years with date filters.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysPartYear
methods.description: Checks filtering of holidays for a specific partial year period.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysCheckUniqueness
methods.description: Ensures that search results are unique and correctly filtered by offset and limit parameters.

methods.name: compareHolidays
methods.description: Helper method to compare two lists of Holiday objects for equality.

methods.name: compareHoliday
methods.description: Helper method to compare two individual Holiday objects for specific attributes.
